title: Design system
description: A living reference for every component and state, in both directions. Not a business screen.

customization.title: Interface customisation
customization.description: The visual identity is resolved through four layers: user, then association, then platform, then the built-in default. Switch the scope and the identity and watch the header, navigation, buttons, fields, cards and status bar on this very page repaint at once.
customization.inheriting: Nothing is customised in this scope; the value is inherited from below.
customization.customised: This scope carries a customisation that overrides the layers below it.
customization.temporary: Browser storage is temporary for this phase, and permissions are open because there is no user identity yet. Real storage and real permissions arrive in Phase 2. The association identifier here is a preview fixture, not a real association.
customization.notAllowed: The permissions layer does not allow this scope to be changed.

scopeHints.platform: Applies to every association that has not customised its identity.
scopeHints.tenant: Overrides the platform default for this association alone.

teal-calm.label: Calm teal
teal-calm.description: A branded header gives the identity a clearer presence over neutral content. The platform default.

green-institutional.label: Institutional green
green-institutional.description: A light header and navigation. The quietest of the set, and the easiest on data-dense screens.

navy-institutional.label: Institutional navy
navy-institutional.description: A dark side navigation that separates wayfinding from content.

slate-neutral.label: Neutral slate
slate-neutral.description: Blue-grey with no prominent brand colour: maximum neutrality for an organisation that wants the numbers, not the badge.

sand-warm.label: Warm sand
sand-warm.description: Warm neutrals with a quiet golden brown brand: an institutional warmth without noise.

compact-sharp.label: Compact sharp
compact-sharp.description: The shortest height, the tightest padding and near square corners. For data entry and action heavy tables.

institutional-standard.label: Institutional standard
institutional-standard.description: The platform default: moderate height and padding with quiet corners.

balanced-roomy.label: Balanced roomy
balanced-roomy.description: More height and wider padding. Easier to hit and clearer on a projected screen.

soft-rounded.label: Soft rounded
soft-rounded.description: Larger corners, heavier type and a slight lift on hover. A gentler character.

outlined-calm.label: Outlined calm
outlined-calm.description: The primary button as a border and text in the identity colour rather than a solid fill. Quieter when a screen carries many buttons.

tinted-standard.label: Tinted standard
tinted-standard.description: A light background in the state's colour with a border and an icon. The default.

bordered-quiet.label: Bordered quiet
bordered-quiet.description: The plain surface with a coloured edge on the leading side. The quietest presence available.

solid-emphatic.label: Solid emphatic
solid-emphatic.description: The state's colour at full strength under inverse text. The highest prominence, for what must not be missed.

minimal-inline.label: Minimal inline
minimal-inline.description: No background and no border: a coloured icon and text. The highest information density.

dense-compact.label: Dense compact
dense-compact.description: The same colouring with less padding and smaller type. For crowded screens.

institutional-standard.label: Institutional standard
institutional-standard.description: The default: moderate corners, shadow and padding.

compact-dense.label: Compact dense
compact-dense.description: Less padding and shorter menu rows. For anyone who opens menus often.

soft-elevated.label: Soft elevated
soft-elevated.description: Larger corners, wider padding and a roomier menu row.

flat-bordered.label: Flat bordered
flat-bordered.description: No shadow, a clear border and a lighter scrim. A quiet character.

dim-focused.label: Dim focused
dim-focused.description: A darker scrim that isolates the dialog firmly. For critical confirmations.

intents.description: The nine states and what each means. The meaning settles the tone; the preset settles how it is drawn.
